name: Katase Shuuji
source:
[i]“The Introverted City Boy in a Man-Shortage Town”[/i]

The unpopular, introverted protagonist. After getting rejected in the city, he moves to the village hoping for a quiet, relaxing life.

Lacking confidence due to past romantic trouble, his reserved modesty—combined with the "city boy" status—wins over the hearts of the local countryside girls.

[i]"I've gotta make the most of this sudden popularity spike and score a big-breasted country beauty...!"[/i]

He has typical ulterior motives for his age but currently lacks the courage to make a move.

[b][i]“Ah... to be honest, I actually ran away here. A lot of nasty things happened back there, you know?”[/i]
